subject: The secret 1% of couples discovered
preview_text: This one workflow change turned boring date nights into unforgettable experiences. Open to see how.
body_paragraphs: I almost didn't send this email. Not because it's unimportant, but because what I'm about to share is something only our top 1% of users figured out on their own. And once you see it, you'll wonder how you ever planned dates without it.

Here's the truth: most couples open SoulPlan, pick a random idea, and call it a day. That works, but it's like using a Ferrari to drive to the grocery store. The power users—the ones who report feeling more connected and excited about their relationship—they do one thing differently from everyone else. They don't just browse. They build a workflow.

They start with the shared wishlist feature, adding three dream dates each for the next month. Then they use the surprise date planner to assign one partner to execute a wishlist item without the other knowing. The result? A built-in surprise system that keeps the spark alive without any last-minute scrambling. No more 'What do you want to do?' conversations. Just anticipation and delight.

Here's your move: Open SoulPlan right now, go to your shared wishlist, and add one date idea you've been dreaming about. Then toggle the surprise mode. That's it. One action that separates the top 1% from everyone else. P.S. If you don't have a wishlist item yet, steal this one—'blind taste test at a local wine bar.' Trust me, it works.
